detail.title: Mechanisms of Autonomous Problem Selection and Intrinsic Motivation
detail.summary: We synthesize findings on curiosity-driven learning and intrinsic motivation frameworks within autonomous agents to evaluate how problems can be discovered and prioritized without external reward shaping.
